body:
Explains inherited building craft to Alyhotep; Shogun is explicitly a joking title.

Recorded role and choices

Osu introduces Yoshida as a lead architect and explicitly says that he is not a shogun. During the ensuing conversation, Yoshida describes carefully fitted wood and stone, generational knowledge and magic as a tool for excellent work rather than a replacement for craftsmanship. His account of the dignity and contentment of Rahu workers remains his perspective. The Codex does not turn the nickname into a military office.
